newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end at new year-low on devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end at new year-low on devaluation.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slid to a new year-low on Tuesday after the central bank devalued the rupee by 3.79 percent against the dollar, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 19.87 points, or 1.47 percent, to end at 1,332.14. Losers beat gainers 152 to 54.
"The market, already faced with hard times, has been hard hit by the rupee devaluation," one dealer said. "For individual investors, dollars are now the safest investment."
Nishat Tek fell 2.0 rupees to 5 and Pak State Oil 13 to 310.
